ios.desc:
StockDuty is PagerDuty for investors. It monitors the stocks you own and sends you a push alert the moment something moves — price swings, volume spikes, breaking news, and SEC filings. Beyond alerts, StockDuty gives you institutional-grade analysis on every ticker in your watchlist: quant model scores, intelligent equity ratings, and investor psychology sentiment.

ALERTS — Know instantly
• Price moves, volume spikes, breaking news, and SEC filings
• Alerts delivered as push notifications, Telegram, or email
• 15 news categories: Earnings, Macro, FDA, Geopolitics, Tech/AI, and more
• Priority-scored feed ranked by market impact

FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS — Intelligent equity analyst
• Buy/Sell/Hold calls on every ticker with entry/stop/target levels
• Business quality score, valuation assessment, and risk analysis
• On-demand generation with conviction rating

QUANT MODELS — Institutional-grade scoring
• Composite quant confidence score (0–100)
• Universe and sector rankings within S&P 500
• 6-month bear/base/bull price targets
• Factor decomposition showing what's driving the score

SENTIMENT — Investor Psychology Score
• Bullish/Bearish direction with 0–100 conviction
• 8 components: expectations gap, narrative momentum, positioning, reflexivity, attention, management trust, catalyst pressure, behavioral risk

StockDuty is free to use . Sign in with just your email — no password, no credit card. Your watchlist syncs between iPhone, and the StockDuty web dashboard.

StockDuty is for informational and educational purposes only and is not investment advice. Markets involve risk.
